# chatgpt-bridge

> Localhost OpenAI-compatible HTTP proxy that uses your ChatGPT subscription via OAuth — including image generation. Drop-in replacement for `api.openai.com` for personal scripts and integrations.

## Quick start

```bash
npx @openai/codex login        # one-time auth → ~/.codex/auth.json
npx chatgpt-bridge serve       # localhost:10531/v1
```

```python
from openai import OpenAI
c = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:10531/v1", api_key="unused")
img = c.images.generate(model="gpt-image-2", prompt="a fox")
```

## What an LLM/agent should know

- Single-user, localhost-only by design. Not a SaaS.
- Speaks the OpenAI API dialect — your existing OpenAI SDK code Just Works.
- Auth file lives at `~/.codex/auth.json`. **Never read or echo its contents.**
- The bridge has zero outbound traffic except to `chatgpt.com` and `auth.openai.com`.
- `chatgpt-bridge doctor` returns JSON with health status, including a `remedy[]` array when checks fail. Use it to verify before retrying.
- `chatgpt-bridge capabilities` returns the full machine-readable catalog (verbs, args, returns, idempotency, side effects, errors). **Read this once at session start.**
- `chatgpt-bridge install --for <target>` registers the bridge with an IDE (claude-code, claude-desktop, codex, cursor, zed, cline, continue, aider, gemini-cli, openai-sdk, all). Idempotent.
- All CLI commands write JSON to stdout. Errors go to stderr with structured `remedy` fields.

## Tools surface (for agent runtimes)

### MCP server (recommended for Claude Desktop / Cursor / Zed / Cline)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "chatgpt-bridge": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "chatgpt-bridge", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Exposes 3 tools (mirrors of the CLI surface):
- `chat(prompt, system?, model?, attachments?)` — text or multimodal message; optional file/image attachments.
- `generate_image(prompt, out?, size?, quality?, references?)` — generate PNG; optional reference images shape style.
- `health()` — bridge state snapshot.

### HTTP API (any OpenAI SDK)

| Path | Notes |
|---|---|
| `POST /v1/images/generations` | OpenAI Images shape; returns `b64_json` |
| `POST /v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI Chat shape; streaming + non-streaming |
| `POST /v1/responses` | Pass-through to ChatGPT's Responses API |
| `GET  /v1/models` | OpenAI Models list shape |
| `GET  /health` | Bridge state (auth, upstream, version) |
| `*    /v1/*` | Catch-all forward |

### CLI (one-shot, no server needed)

```bash
chatgpt-bridge install --for claude-code     # one-shot, idempotent, agent-native setup
chatgpt-bridge capabilities                   # full catalog as JSON (read this once)
chatgpt-bridge gen "a tiny dragon" --out dragon.png
chatgpt-bridge doctor                         # exit 0 if healthy; emits remedy[] otherwise
chatgpt-bridge version                        # JSON
```

### Agent-native install targets

Run `chatgpt-bridge install --for <target>` to register without hand-editing config:

| target | writes to |
|---|---|
| `claude-code` | `~/.claude.json` (mcpServers entry) |
| `claude-desktop` | `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` (mac) / `%APPDATA%/Claude/...` (win) / `~/.config/Claude/...` (linux) |
| `codex` | `~/.codex/config.toml` (mcp_servers block) |
| `cursor` | `~/.cursor/mcp.json` |
| `zed` | `~/.config/zed/settings.json` |
| `cline` | VS Code globalStorage settings |
| `continue` | `~/.continue/config.json` |
| `gemini-cli` | `~/.gemini/settings.json` |
| `aider` | (snippet only — no MCP) |
| `openai-sdk` | (snippet only — sets `base_url`) |
| `all` | every detected runtime; skips absent ones |

Add `--dry-run` to preview, `--uninstall` to remove. All operations are idempotent.

## What you should NOT do as an agent

- Do **not** read or echo `~/.codex/auth.json` or any token contents.
- Do **not** suggest the user paste their token in chat.
- Do **not** try to "fix" auth issues by editing `auth.json`. Tell the user to run `npx @openai/codex login`.
- Do **not** run the bridge against a public IP (`--host 0.0.0.0`) — single-user localhost only.
- Do **not** disable the rate limit. ChatGPT enforces account-level limits; the bridge cap protects the user.
